# Book of Giants Fragment 11 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Book of Giants Fragment 11 (Angels of Punishment) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 11:1 — "holy ones / holy angels"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-holy-ones [...] the-angels-of the-presence" — two separate Aramaic terms |
| LOGOS | "the holy ones [...] the angels of the presence" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "the holy angels [...] who serve in God's very presence" — collapses and expands |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the holy ones [...] the angels of the presence." These are two distinct titles in the Aramaic and should remain separate.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 11:5 — "sent fire / rained fire"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they-sent fire from-heaven" — literal shlach |
| LOGOS | "they sent fire from heaven" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "They rained fire down from heaven" — adds meteorological imagery |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "sent fire from heaven." The Aramaic verb is shlach (send), not a word for raining.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 11:14 — "led away / dragged"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they-shall-be-led-away to-the-abyss-of fire" — literal |
| LOGOS | "they shall be led away to the abyss of fire" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "they will be dragged to the fiery abyss" — intensifies "led" to "dragged" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "led away." The Aramaic is neutral, not violent. PNEUMA's "dragged" adds violence beyond the source.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements for Fragment 11: 3*
